title: Grade 2 Science — Mon, Jun 01
description: Plants Around Us — Day 1 of 5: Parts of a plant
subject: science

questions.question: Which part of a plant is usually under the ground?
questions.explanation: Roots grow under the ground and hold the plant firmly in the soil.

questions.question: Which part of the plant is green and makes food?
questions.explanation: Leaves are green and make food for the plant using sunlight.

questions.question: What carries water from the roots to the leaves?
questions.explanation: The stem holds the plant up and carries water from the roots to other parts.

questions.question: Which part of a plant is often colourful and sweet-smelling?
questions.explanation: Flowers are usually colourful and may smell sweet. They later become fruits.

questions.question: Roots help the plant by:
options: Holding it in the soil and taking in water
questions.explanation: Roots fix the plant in the soil and absorb water and minerals.

questions.question: From which part of the plant do we get a new plant?
questions.explanation: Seeds grow into new plants when they get water, air and warmth.

questions.question: Which of these is the topmost part of a small plant?
questions.explanation: The part of the plant above the ground (stem, leaves, flowers) is called the shoot.

questions.question: Leaves are usually green because of a colour called:
questions.explanation: Leaves contain a green colour called chlorophyll, which helps them make food.

questions.question: Which part grows first when a seed begins to grow?
questions.explanation: When a seed sprouts, the tiny root comes out first and goes into the soil.

questions.question: The outer covering of a tree's stem is called the:
questions.explanation: The hard outer cover on the stem of a tree is called the bark. It protects the tree.

questions.question: Which part of the plant joins the leaf to the stem?
questions.explanation: A small stalk joins each leaf to the stem of the plant.

questions.question: We eat the root of which plant?
questions.explanation: Carrot is a root that we eat. Many roots like radish and beetroot are eaten too.

questions.question: Which part of the plant turns into a fruit?
questions.explanation: After a flower is done blooming, it slowly changes into a fruit.

questions.question: Why do most plants need their leaves?
questions.explanation: Leaves make food for the whole plant using sunlight, air and water.

questions.question: Put these plant parts in order from bottom to top: leaf, root, stem.
questions.explanation: Roots are at the bottom in the soil, the stem rises up, and leaves grow on the stem.
